task: standard tier 3-7 paragraphs contract: insert \n\n paragraph breaks at sentence boundaries in standard.fragments.json templateTokens
constraints: 의미 보존 (preserve meaning) — only insert \n\n at existing sentence boundaries; no content authored, no sentences split mid-clause

structuralCap.explanation: 323 cells select coverage fragments composed of exactly 2 sentences each (typical floor coverage: floors, season-context, age-band, currentseason etc.). With \n\n inserted at the single sentence boundary they reach 2 paragraphs. Reaching 3 paragraphs would require either splitting mid-sentence (violates ci:narrative-truncated-endings ban on bare 요. endings) or authoring a third sentence (violates 의미 보존 constraint and the broader 'no content authored' guard). Result is the structural cap: 60.85% ge3, target was 80%.

approach.strategy: String-replace surgery on JSON-encoded value strings — preserves original file formatting (no full JSON reformat). Sentence-end regex: `(?<=[가-힣])\.(?:\s+|(?=[가-힣·]))` (require preceding hangul to avoid abbreviations).
approach.multiTokenStrategy: For health_stress (and other multi-text-token fragments), append \n\n suffix to all but the last text token, making each token its own paragraph (no content change).
